entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Order number is VF-8675309.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the Urban Commuter Helmet. I can certainly look into this return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue?
There's no issue. The color is not what I wanted. The box is unopened. Can I return it, yes or no?
I understand. Is it a technical fault with the helmet or just a preference on the color?
It's a preference. I just told you. I don't have time for a lot of questions, just tell me if I can send it back.
Of course, I just need to verify the purchase date against our policy. One moment... Okay, I see the delivery was 67 days ago. That's no problem at all.

Yes, it is. Our policy for standard items allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery, especially when it concerns your satisfaction and safety. I've just approved the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file.
Okay, I see the email. What next?

Just attach that label to the package and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the item, you'll get a full refund to the original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a safe holiday.
